experience.summary: DevOps and platform work for teams shipping services through GitOps: CI/CD pipelines, Kubernetes environments, and internal tools that took manual work out of releases and deployments.
highlights: Built a GitHub App that lets release managers pause merges to main or dev deployments with one switch per repo, instead of editing every repo's workflows during freezes and incidents.
Built an AI agent framework on LangGraph and Claude Code that moved Java/Gradle services onto the platform team's standard Gradle plugins, opening PRs and retrying on CI failures.
Maintained CI/CD pipelines and Kubernetes environments used by several development teams.

experience.name: capgemini
experience.summary: Built the web side of an OCT (optical coherence tomography) imaging system used in heart procedures: Node.js APIs and React dashboards for patient and physician data, heart imaging data, and DICOM images, including a real-time monitoring dashboard. Internal and testing teams used it, and physicians used it to look at data away from the lab.
highlights: Sped up data retrieval with Redis caching and PostgreSQL indexing.
Cut API latency by sending only new readings in smaller updates.
Kept terabytes of patient imaging data in object storage, with metadata and pointers in the database.
Set up CI/CD with Jenkins, Git, and Terraform for Dockerized services.
Automated infrastructure and test work with Bash, Python, and Cypress.
